instructions: `transcript` came from a speech recogniser that invents text on silence or background noise: typically video outros, subtitle credits, calls to subscribe, music captions and stray fragments. Is `transcript` such an invented artefact rather than something the user actually said?

criteria.true: Invented artefact; the user most likely said nothing
criteria.false: A plausible thing for a user to say to a coding assistant, even if very short
